sermon.title: January 7, 2024 — The Word and The Spirit
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer)
sermon.summary: Opening 2024, the message teaches that Jesus is the true vine, and we bear fruit only by abiding in Him and His word, which works like surgery on our spiritual man. The Spirit of wisdom, counsel, might and the fear of the Lord is poured out on all flesh, producing love and the fruit of the Spirit, and the church must return to the demonstration of the Spirit and power.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: The service opens with worship (lyrics as captioned); the message begins at about 25:10. “Psalms 30 1382” in the captions is taken as Psalm 33:4 (“the word of the Lord is right”).
